name: Tsielekjåhkå-Piteälven
difficulty: No official stage-specific difficulty grade found. STF describes the broader Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route as relatively demanding with major elevation changes. Section-specific official and field evidence indicates remote, camping-only open-fell terrain with route-finding risk at summer/winter trail splits, exposed weather, steep/rocky sections and wet/marshy ground near the Piteälven/Tjeggelvas endpoint.
routeType: point-to-point remote mountain section with no road access at either endpoint and camping required

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route page
officialSources.evidence: Identifies stage 2 / etapp 2 as Tsielekjåhkå-Piteälven, 19 km and 7-9 hours, accommodation camping. Describes easy open mountain terrain, Suoŋergårsså ravine, a summer/winter trail split where hikers should choose the western route, Goabddábakte cliff face, mountain birch and pine forest, no cabins and many good camping spots.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan BD77 Kvikkjokk-Piteälven/Västerfjäll route
officialSources.evidence: Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan official route page for the larger Kvikkjokk-Piteälven / Kvikkjokk-Västerfjäll route. Gives split distances Kvikkjokk-Tsielekjåhkå 15 km / 5-7 h and Tsielekjåhkå-Piteälven 19 km / 7-9 h. Warns not to follow the X-marked winter trail toward Parka after Suoŋergårsså and not to turn south toward abandoned Västerfjäll near Gistojávrátj.
officialSources.caveat: This page and linework cover the broader route and are not a discrete section-14-only geometry.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan BD77 GPX
officialSources.evidence: Public GPX for the full Mallenjarka-to-Piteälven/Västerfjäll walking route. Geometry starts after the Sakkat boat and continues from Tsiele to Piteälven.
officialSources.caveat: Not stage-split. Public KML/GeoJSON suffixes returned 404/406 in the section-14 geometry pass; Naturkartan API v3/v3.2 returned 401 invalid api key in that pass.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Tsielekjåkkstugan
officialSources.evidence: Start facility point for Tsielekjåkkstugan / Stopover cabin Tsielekjåkk at 66.8449219123,17.5892590375. Describes open year-round rest cabin with stove, latrine/toilet and emergency telephone.
officialSources.caveat: STF route text treats the hut separately from ordinary STF cabins. Model as unstaffed rest/emergency wilderness hut, not staffed STF cabin.

officialSources.name: Naturvårdsverket/Länsstyrelsen WFS state trail linework
officialSources.evidence: Official WFS feature OBJECTID 2783139 / GmlID LED.2783139 / Led_ID 30424088 / Statlig_led_ID BD77 / Vandringsled BD77 mellan Kvikkjokk och Västerfjäll. Geometry quality <=20 m, direction Mallenjarka to Piteälven/Västerfjäll and usable as primary official base line after splitting.
officialSources.caveat: Not split at Tsiele or as a discrete section 14.

officialSources.name: Naturvårdsverket Anordningar data
officialSources.evidence: Official infrastructure data for suspension bridges, including Hängbro över Tsielekjåhkå and two Hängbro över Fálesjåhko endpoint bridges.

officialSources.evidence: Ready-made section relation named Kungsleden Etapp 19: Tsielekjåkkstugan - Piteälven, from Tsielekjåkkstugan, to Piteälven, distance 19 and wikidata Q134269937. Provides clean OSM continuity with section 13 and section 15 relations.
officialSources.caveat: Use subject to OSM source/licensing policy and Piteälven endpoint convention; OSM endpoint is about 429 m southwest of WFS/Naturkartan endpoint.

officialSources.name: Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten current mountain notices
officialSources.evidence: Current page and linked notices list 2026-04-22 stopped trail checks due unreliable snow/ice, 2026-03-27 changed snow/ice conditions, and a 2026-04-29 SMHI mountain-wind warning banner for Norrbotten.

officialSources.name: Piteälven Natura 2000 conservation plan
officialSources.evidence: Piteälven SE0820434 Natura 2000 plan. Confirms Piteälven natural river values and notes Kungsleden crossing near the old Västerfjäll/Tjieggelvas area.
officialSources.caveat: Rules/currentness lane found Natura hits only at final endpoint/final water area by point sampling; final line/polygon overlay remains needed.

Piteälven/Västerfjäll has no public transport, roadhead or confirmed scheduled boat and should be treated as a remote through-hiking/camping endpoint, not an access trailhead.

wildCamping.summary: STF lists accommodation as Camping and official sources state there are no overnight cabins along section 14. Naturkartan reports many tent pitches with water on open fell between Tsielekjåhkå and Fálesjåhkå.
wildCamping.caveats: Exposed plateau camping can be poor in snow/wind, and marshy endpoint terrain can be poor for tents. Use established low-impact camping judgement.

hutCamping.summary: Tsielekjåkkstugan is at the start and should be treated as emergency/rest shelter with limited capacity, not planned lodging. No hut is found at Piteälven.

fire.summary: No section-specific fire rule found, but fire bans from Länsstyrelsen or municipality override normal outdoor-fire practice. Firepit at Piteälven is OSM-only and should not be imported without current legality/condition verification.

waste.summary: No official waste service confirmed. Field-report-only 2019 waste mention near Pite/Tjeggelvas should not be imported as current service.

protectedAreas.summary: Point sampling of WFS section-14 route against Naturreservat, Natura 2000, Tillträdesförbud and Djur- och växtskyddsområde layers found no hits along 0-18 km. Piteälven Natura 2000 SE0820434 applies at the final Piteälven/Tjieggelvas water area. Pärlälvens fjällurskog and Kvikkjokk-Kabla should not be attached to section 14 unless a later true line/polygon overlay contradicts point sampling.
protectedAreas.openOverlayCaveat: Run true GIS line/polygon overlay before normalized import.

dogs.summary: All of Norrbotten is within the reindeer-herding area according to Länsstyrelsen's 2026 notice. Where reindeer are present and herding is permitted, dogs must be leashed or securely confined unless Länsstyrelsen grants otherwise. From 1 March to 20 August dogs require extra supervision; in practice keep dogs leashed.

reindeer.summary: STF notes reindeer herding on the Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route and Naturkartan notes a reindeer fence on this stage. Reindeer are especially sensitive around April-June calving.
reindeer.openQuestion: Confirm exact sameby overlap for this section with Sametinget/Länsstyrelsen GIS before import.

fireBans.summary: No section-specific fire restriction found, but fire bans can be issued by Länsstyrelsen or municipality and must be checked before public use.

hunting.summary: Small-game hunting on state land above the cultivation boundary is managed by Länsstyrelsen/NatureIT. No hiker closure found, but areas can close/limit due to hunting pressure or reindeer-herding disturbance.
hunting.openQuestion: Check NatureIT active hunting-area status for exact corridor before publication.

fishing.summary: Jokkmokk mountain fishing rules apply where fishing is offered; Piteälven endpoint is Natura-sensitive water. Do not expose fishing metadata without checking Jokkmokkskortet/water-specific exceptions.

drones.summary: No section-specific drone ban found in sampled restriction layers. Normal Swedish drone rules and Lantmäteriet dissemination permit rules apply.
drones.openQuestion: If final overlay places any part inside a protected area with local drone/start-landing restrictions, add area-specific rules.

conditionReports.sourceName: A Tog's Trek, Etapp 14 - Tsielekjåkk to Vuonatjviken
conditionReports.reportDate: page shows 30 Jul; year not exposed in fetched page
conditionReports.findings: Tsiele shelter has emergency supplies, drop toilet needing repair at time of report, chain bridge, good north-bank campsites, fewer hikers, muddy/marshy ground, short water gaps, heavy forest/marsh farther south and mosquito swarms in still weather.
conditionReports.caveat: Broad route spans beyond section 14; do not attribute broken bridge or farther-south issues to section 14 unless geometry proves it.

conditionReports.sourceName: The Long Walks, Days 11-13: Kvikkjokk to Hof Vuonatjviken
conditionReports.findings: Snow and strong wind after Tsiele, plateau not suitable for camping in those conditions, red markings visible about every 100 m, camp below snow line near Ruovddejávrre, bridge over Pite river reached next morning.

conditionReports.sourceName: The Long Walks, Ruovddejavrre to below Tjäurakåtan
conditionReports.findings: Bridge over Pite river after about 7 km from Ruovddejávrre camp and useful camping intelligence around Pite/Tjäurakåtan transition.
Around 400 m ascent and at least 20 km; plateau reached after about an hour; Pite Älv visible with about 8 km still to go; reindeer near endpoint; calm evening with campfire.
Reverse-direction report confirms Ruovddejávrre stream/campsite, steep 300 m climb toward Goabddábakte, wide views, reindeer, easy plateau and slippery ravine descent toward Tsiele.
conditionReports.confidence: high for reverse-direction terrain and campsite/water notes

conditionReports.findings: Wet/muddy shoes even in a dry year; campsite at Tjeggelvas with toilet/garbage/pans at time of visit; two suspension bridges over Piteälven; willow/birch narrowing the trail; mosquitoes around swampy camps.
conditionReports.caveat: Mostly just south of the section-14 endpoint but useful endpoint context; waste service is stale and not import-ready.

agents.result: Confirmed official STF identity, Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen broader route identity, official distance/time, route-finding warnings, Tsiele start POI, Piteälven/Västerfjäll endpoint naming and official source caveats.
Documented WFS BD77, Naturkartan GPX and OSM/Waymarked relation 18864492 geometry, computed split distances, adjacent-section continuity and Piteälven endpoint conflict.
